translations.web: I will save you from all your uncleanness. I will call for the grain, and will multiply it, and lay no famine on you.
translations.bsb: I will save you from all your uncleanness. I will summon the grain and make it plentiful, and I will not bring famine upon you.
translations.kjv: I will also save you from all your uncleannesses: and I will call for the corn, and will increase it, and lay no famine
translations.asv: And I will save you from all your uncleannesses: and I will call for the grain, and will multiply it, and lay no famine upon you.
